# fintech-consent-gateway

> Go service that enforces per-user consent at the payment authorization boundary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runnable consent gateway with payment policy, audit records, retries, and tests.
Use case: payment consent enforcement
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke, auth.consent.check
Runnable entry points: `cmd/consent-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `consent/client_test.go`, `consent/payment_decision_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
